ctaHeading: Point Cook's flooring team is ready to help — let's transform your space.
aboutText: Tuff Build Construction brings extensive experience to Point Cook, offering expert flooring services for residential and commercial properties. From tile laying to timber refinishing, we handle every project with precision and care. Our commitment to quality workmanship makes us a trusted name in the local community, serving Point Cook and surrounding areas.
servicesText: We provide a wide range of flooring services in Point Cook, including installation, repair, and maintenance. Our skilled team works with various materials to deliver durable and aesthetically pleasing results.

services.title: Tile Installation
services.desc: Expert laying of ceramic, porcelain, and natural stone tiles for kitchens, bathrooms, and living areas.

services.title: Timber Flooring
services.desc: Professional installation and sanding of solid and engineered timber floors for a warm, natural look.

services.title: Vinyl Flooring
services.desc: Durable and water-resistant vinyl installations, perfect for high-traffic areas and modern designs.

services.title: Laminate Flooring
services.desc: Affordable and versatile laminate options that mimic wood or stone with easy maintenance.

services.title: Floor Preparation
services.desc: Thorough levelling, cleaning, and priming to ensure a perfect base for any flooring material.

services.title: Underfloor Heating
services.desc: Efficient heating systems installed beneath tiles or timber for cosy warmth during colder months.
